name: How does weather in the Bay Area affect window flashing durability and repair?

mainEntity.name: How does weather in the Bay Area affect window flashing durability and repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Bay Area's diverse weather, including fog, rain, and coastal winds, significantly impacts window flashing durability. Persistent moisture from fog can slowly degrade sealants and flashing materials over time, even without heavy downpours. Strong winds can drive rain into small gaps, exploiting any weaknesses in the flashing system. The cyclical expansion and contraction from temperature fluctuations can also stress materials, leading to cracks. Therefore, Bay Area homes require high-quality, properly installed flashing designed to withstand these specific conditions, and regular inspections are crucial to catch issues before they escalate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bay Area weather, including fog, rain, and winds, degrades flashing over time, driving water into gaps. High-quality, climate-appropriate installation and regular inspection are essential for durability.
